versions.changelog:
- Initial release enabling post-match review generation for World Cup football matches.
- Supports standardized scene input, post-match information retrieval, and extraction of fan group notification highlights.
- Allows users to focus on specific teams, players, or groups, and select from concise summaries, analysis, best performer highlights, and post-match talking points.
- Automatically distinguishes match status (ended, in progress, not started) before generating appropriate review content.
- Designed for clear, fact-based, directly usable summaries tailored for sharing in group chats and fan communities.
